input: Evidence-validated Daily Runtime publications for 2026-09-07 through 2026-09-13; current main Scheduler V3.0, Worker Control v1.3.0 and generated Weekly Prompt v2.1.0; verified Weekly wake receipt research/runtime/wakes/2026/09/2026-09-13/weekly-202922.json; the fresh 2026-09-13 Weekly Execution Slot Opened and Worker Claimed events; the latest P2 Registry and P2 Special Study Contract; current editorial/evidence policies; the 2026-09-06 completed P2 checkpoints; and current primary GitHub evidence for all four due biweekly-or-release P2 objects.
input_zh: 2026-09-07 至 2026-09-13 已通过证据验证的 Daily Runtime Publication、当前 main 上的 Scheduler V3.0 / Worker Control v1.3.0 / Generated Weekly Prompt v2.1.0、已核验的 Weekly Wake Receipt research/runtime/wakes/2026/09/2026-09-13/weekly-202922.json、2026-09-13 fresh Weekly Execution Slot Opened 与 Worker Claimed 事件、最新 P2 Registry 与 P2 Special Study Contract、当前编辑/证据政策、2026-09-06 已完成 P2 检查点，以及全部 4 个到期 biweekly-or-release P2 对象的当前 GitHub 一手证据。
workResult: Global serial admission verified that all earlier applicable 2026-09-13 formal tasks were execution-closed before Weekly received authority. Weekly examined the seven-date window from September 7 through September 13 and admitted only evidence-validated published Daily Research: six days have durable Completed Publication results totaling 14 Research Center notes; September 11 Publication remains Running in the current authoritative Daily Runtime record, so unpublished September 11 candidates were explicitly excluded rather than inferred complete. The cross-week synthesis identifies a recurring typed-closure problem: state integrity, execution authority, external-effect reconciliation and evidence coverage are distinct closure claims. A local terminal state must not silently close another dimension. Weekly 009 therefore introduces Typed Closure as an engineering abstraction with State, Authority, Effect and Coverage dimensions and preserves Unknown or Bounded as durable states. P2 resolved all four due biweekly-or-release objects; agent-audit, Aegis, agent-style and cs-paper-checklist retain the exact main/release identities from their September 6 checkpoints. The two monthly objects are not due because September full reviews already completed on September 6. Zero due objects reached trigger score 5, so no full P2 Special Study was manufactured.
workResult_zh: 全局串行准入已确认 2026-09-13 当日所有更早适用正式任务均已执行收口，Weekly 才获得执行权。Weekly 检查 9 月 7 日至 13 日的七日期窗口，并只接纳已通过证据验证且完成发布的 Daily Research：6 个日期存在持久化 Completed Publication 结果，共 14 篇 Research Center 研究；9 月 11 日 Publication 在当前权威 Daily Runtime 中仍为 Running，因此本期明确排除当天未发布 Candidate，没有把它推断为完成。本周跨研究对象反复出现的是 Typed Closure 问题：State Integrity、Execution Authority、External-effect Reconciliation 与 Evidence Coverage 是不同的终态命题，一种局部终态不能静默关闭另一种终态。Weekly 009 因此提出 Typed Closure 工程抽象，分离 State、Authority、Effect 与 Coverage，并保留 Unknown / Bounded 作为可持久状态。P2 的 4 个到期 biweekly-or-release 对象全部收口；agent-audit、Aegis、agent-style 与 cs-paper-checklist 的 main / release 身份均与 9 月 6 日检查点完全一致。2 个 monthly 对象因 9 月 6 日已完成本月完整复查，本周不到期。0 个到期对象达到 5 分触发阈值，因此没有人为制造完整 P2 专项研究。
output: Weekly 009 — Completion Must Be Typed: One Green Check Cannot Close the Whole System, published as independent Chinese and English Weekly Research pages with a Typed Closure editorial cover; plus a contract-valid 2026-09-13 P2 run covering all four due objects, explicitly recording two monthly objects as not due, and starting zero Special Studies.
output_zh: 发布 Weekly 009《“完成”必须带类型：一个绿灯不能关闭整个系统》的中英文独立 Weekly Research 页面与 Typed Closure 编辑题图；同时形成符合合同的 2026-09-13 P2 运行记录，覆盖全部 4 个到期对象、明确记录 2 个 monthly 对象本周不到期，并启动 0 个专项研究。
next: Next week, test transition contracts between closure dimensions: which state changes reopen authority; when unknown external effects must escalate instead of retry; when bounded coverage is sufficient for a risk decision; how new evidence sources invalidate prior coverage closure; and how independently responsible workers prove that separate closure events belong to the same occurrence. Separately reconcile the unfinished 2026-09-11 Publication through its own governed recovery path; Weekly did not rewrite that historical task state.
next_zh: 下一周优先验证不同 Closure 维度之间的转换合同：哪些 State 变化必须重新打开 Authority、外部效果 Unknown 在何种条件下必须升级而不是继续重试、Bounded Coverage 在什么风险等级下足以支持决定、新证据源如何使旧 Coverage Closure 失效，以及承担独立责任的不同 Worker 如何证明各自终态属于同一个 Occurrence。另需通过 2026-09-11 Publication 自身的受治理恢复路径处理其未收口状态；Weekly 没有改写该历史任务状态。
